items.question: How far in advance should I place my order?
items.answer: We offer pickup and delivery in Manila. Delivery availability and fees are shown when you place your order.

items.question: What days are you open?
items.answer: We are open for orders and fulfillment every Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.

items.question: Where can I pick up my order?
items.answer: For the best quality and freshness, keep your pie refrigerated and follow the storage instructions provided with your order.

items.question: Can I order a whole pie or smaller portions?
items.answer: Yes. We offer whole pies, mini pies, and petit pies, as well as bundles for sharing.
